# intutic_siem_destination (Resource)

A SIEM export destination (`/api/v1/siem/destinations`): where the workspace streams governance events, and which ones. SIEM export needs the Biz Org, Enterprise or Self-host plan (or a trial); on another plan the API refuses to create or change a destination. The adapter's credentials go in `secret_config`, everything else in `config`. A `webhook_https` destination signs every delivery with a secret the API generates, returns once and Terraform keeps as `signing_secret`; `secret_rotation_triggers` replaces it. Destroying the resource deactivates the destination: the API has no delete, so it stays listed, switched off. Needs an OWNER or ADMIN key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A signed webhook that receives incidents and every gate decision, with a
# signing secret replaced every 90 days.
resource "time_rotating" "siem_webhook" {
  rotation_days = 90
}

resource "intutic_siem_destination" "webhook" {
  name          = "SOC webhook"
  adapter_type  = "webhook_https"
  config        = jsonencode({ webhookUrl = "https://siem.example.com/intutic" })
  secret_config = { authHeaderValue = "Bearer ${var.soc_webhook_token}" }
  source_tables = ["governance_incidents", "gate_decisions"]

  secret_rotation_triggers = {
    rotated = time_rotating.siem_webhook.id
  }
}

# Splunk HTTP Event Collector, default sources.
resource "intutic_siem_destination" "splunk" {
  name          = "Splunk"
  adapter_type  = "splunk_hec"
  config        = jsonencode({ hecUrl = "https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector", sourcetype = "intutic" })
  secret_config = { token = var.splunk_hec_token }
}

# The receiver verifies each delivery with this secret.
output "siem_webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = intutic_siem_destination.webhook.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}

variable "soc_webhook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "splunk_hec_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adapter_type` (String) One of `syslog_cef`, `webhook_https`, `gcs`, `s3`, `splunk_hec`, `datadog_logs`. Changing it replaces the destination.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `batch_size` (Number) Events per bucket object (`gcs`, `s3`). Defaults to 100.
- `config` (String) The adapter's settings as a JSON object, without its credentials. Required keys: `syslog_cef` `host` and `port`; `webhook_https` `webhookUrl`; `splunk_hec` `hecUrl`; `gcs` and `s3` `bucketName`. Optional ones include `useTls` (syslog), `prefix` and `projectId` (gcs), `region` and `accessKeyId` (s3), `source` and `sourcetype` (splunk), `intakeUrl` and `hostname` (datadog). URLs must be public https endpoints.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `flush_interval_ms` (Number) Longest wait, in milliseconds, before a bucket object is written with fewer events. Defaults to 60000.
- `secret_config` (Map of String, Sensitive) The adapter's credentials, which the API only ever returns masked: `webhook_https` `authHeaderValue` (optional); `splunk_hec` `token`; `datadog_logs` `apiKey`; `gcs` `credentials` (a base64-encoded service-account key); `s3` `secretAccessKey`. A value changed outside Terraform shows as a difference.
- `secret_rotation_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that rotate the signing secret when they change. Changing, adding or removing any value replaces a `webhook_https` destination's signing secret in place on the next apply and stores the new one in `signing_secret`; the old secret stops working at once. Creating the resource does not rotate, since the API issues a secret then. Only for a `webhook_https` destination.
- `source_tables` (Set of String) The event sources to stream, for example `governance_incidents` or `gate_decisions`. Empty (the default) streams every source except the opt-in ones; `gate_decisions` is sent only to a destination that lists it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The destination id (`siemdest_…`).
- `paused_reason` (String) Why an enabled destination streams nothing, such as a plan without SIEM export; null while it streams.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) For `webhook_https`: the secret that signs each delivery. Set on create and when `secret_rotation_triggers` changes; null after an import, since the API returns it only then.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by destination id. Credentials read back masked, so set secret_config
# to the real values. The signing secret is never returned after creation:
# add secret_rotation_triggers to put a new one in state.
terraform import intutic_siem_destination.splunk siemdest_0123456789abcdef
```
